                               ENVIRONMENT [--yes] [--expect-grant SHA256]
                               [--restricted]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --stack DIR
  --json
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
  --yes                 Confirm the changed grant
  --expect-grant SHA256
  --restricted          Deploy as restricted service accounts under the
                        admission policies (preview, not yet run on kind)
